item: the local ring merge and the sources import read through the guarded loader; the three mechanisms of F5 named
summary: merge_local_rings and SourceManager.import_sources_from_yaml used the pure yaml.safe_load: crash-safe, but a 100,000-deep file raised an uncaught RecursionError at about 500 levels. Both now use load_safe_yaml, so it is refused as YAMLDepthError on both loader paths (2.7 ms through libyaml's event pass, 1,385 ms through the pure loader, medians of 5); the ring merge refuses and leaves the file untouched. F5 is now complete: (1) a restored backup writes the local rings file unparsed (backup/merge.py), (2) equivalence._read_yaml parses it at ring load (#1569), (3) ring_loader.merge_local_rings parses it before a Wikidata merge (this row). Stated limit: the only route to import_sources_from_yaml (POST /api/sources/import) builds a fixed path to configs/sources.yml and never takes a caller's file, so no route reaches a hostile file today and no 4xx mapping was added (that path, written with four .parent hops from src/api/source_management.py, resolves one directory ABOVE the repo root, so the route itself fails with FileNotFoundError: a separate defect, reported, not fixed here). extract.py:430 (stopwords-extra dir) is the keyword lane's; the 17 other safe_load sites read shipped, unwritable config.
